run.title: Build & Run Hermes
run.command: xcodebuild -project Hermes.xcodeproj -scheme Hermes -derivedDataPath build -destination 'platform=macOS,arch=arm64' build && (pkill -x Hermes; open -n build/Build/Products/Debug/Hermes.app --args -HermesStorage /tmp/hermes-dev)

agent_prompt: Hermes is a native macOS menu bar app (no simulators or web runtime). Build and test with xcodebuild from app/Hermes using the worktree-local -derivedDataPath build. Run dev builds with -HermesStorage /tmp/hermes-dev so the real shelf is left alone.
